metadata.description: Dedicated Azure Blob coordination boundary for one NaC BFF performance run.
Azure region for the dedicated coordination storage account.
Exact Entra tenant bound by the combined owner approval.
Exact Azure subscription bound by the combined owner approval.
Exact Azure resource group bound by the combined owner approval.
Deployment mode binding. The CLI and template accept Incremental only.
Globally unique name for the dedicated performance-coordination storage account.
Authoritative ARM resource ID of the existing BFF host/deployment storage account. The account name is derived from this ID.
Authoritative ARM resource ID of the existing WORM evidence storage account. The account name is derived from this ID.
Object ID of the owner-gated application service principal allowed to call the fixed broker route. It receives no Storage DataAction.
Authoritative ARM resource ID of the BFF Function App hosting the fixed lease broker.
SHA-256 of the exact deployed BFF Function package containing the broker implementation.
SHA-256 of the public certificate used by the broker to verify short-lived activation tickets.
Hash binding used as the only lease blob basename.
Additional non-sensitive tags. Coordination boundary tags cannot be overridden.
